title: Twin Bridge Campground

services.name: Cozy Cabin
services.desc: Click here for a Virtual Tour of Twin Bridge Campground in Chambersburg PA to tour the property and pick your perfect campsite! Centrally located near the pavilion, with easy access to activities like mini golf, The Deluxe Cabin offers a rustic pine interior and all the comforts of home. The separate bedroom features a twin over full bunk bed and a twin futon, while another twin futon is located in the living area. This pet-friendly cabin includes a full residential kitchen with an oven/stovetop, refrigerator, and a full bathroom with a shower/tub combo.
